title: SDK build repair telemetry report (v1)
description: Machine-readable telemetry payload embedded in the auto-build-repair PR summary comment. Emitted by emit-repair-report.ps1 on EVERY terminal state and mirrored by CloudMine from the GitHub issues/comments stream. Kept intentionally tiny: only the fields needed to compute (or key the joins for) the in-scope success metrics. Values are sourced from the engine result files, git, and $GITHUB_* env - never authored by the model.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump to v2 for any breaking field change so downstream Kusto queries can pin.

pr.description: Pull request number the repair ran against. Join key for CloudMine outcome metrics.

head_sha.description: PR head sha at the time the repair ran.

eligible.description: Whether the PR passed the Auto SDK PR eligibility gate. Denominator input for metric 1.

status.description: Terminal outcome. repaired = build green after repair; failed = still red at a stop condition; ineligible = not an Auto SDK PR (no engine run); skipped_already_green = package already built, no repair needed.

repaired_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the green build. Set ONLY when status=repaired; null otherwise. Anchors metric 2 (subsequent human correction) and metric 3 (time-to-green) in CloudMine joins.
